recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-39928 unless a separate issue decides to modernize all RFC links away from tools.ietf.org.
issue_request: FHIR-39928 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-core HTTP and asked to fix the JSON Patch specification link in the patch section because the RFC URL ended with an extra period and was broken.
initial_application: No FHIR-39928-tagged source commit was found. The malformed URL traces to the older FHIR-16370 implementation commit c72549f8dbbb9001c72f2c07aeec257b024b476f, which changed source/http.html from jsonpatch.com to https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902. with the period included. Commit 1c497f9eb0cf35409935688fdef380293a377c23 later removed that trailing period.
additional_context: FHIR-16370 is the same FHIR-core HTTP link family and explains why JSON Patch links to the RFC. source/hierarchy.xml actively includes the RESTful API page and the REST exchange page. Current source/http.html and source/exchanging-rest.html both use https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc6902 without a trailing period. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already satisfies the narrow published correction, and changing the otherwise valid RFC link target would exceed the issue scope.

related_jiras.note: Earlier Published issue that changed the JSON Patch link to the RFC URL and whose implementation introduced the trailing-period typo later reported by FHIR-39928.
